scope: Isolated pure preparation-record decoder, source/ancestry binder and runnable metadata comparison. No production entry imports the helper yet; no build, strip or saved workload ran.
source_manifest_encoding: UTF-8 sorted compact JSON, no trailing newline

python_tests.scope: Synthetic dictionaries/bytes and standard-library mocks. Tests construct metadata for original/derived artifacts without reading or executing such artifacts.
python_tests.name_list_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array of [method, full parenthesized unittest identifier including __main__.Class.method] pairs in actual log order, no trailing newline

source_behavior: Exact raw canonical-LF metadata bytes must match the externally supplied v3 contract hash before JSON parsing and field validation. Closed types reject duplicate/nonfinite/unknown material; the existing 128 KiB metadata bound is retained.

The complete project-local manifest remains in the trusted contract. A separately supplied verified source summary binds count and bytes without duplicating the map; compiler, lock/toolchain, explicit build controls and unique Cargo-selected original are cross-checked. Historical preparation facts are not re-executed or inferred from successful parsing.

Original and runnable content identities remain separate. An optional fresh GNU strip relation binds tool, flags and output metadata; an unchanged-content preserved original copy may have a different path/mode. Actual descriptor-derived runnable facts are compared only in the second pure phase.

No-flush ancestry reverses exactly one complete line in the bounded current source and reconstructs the baseline manifest/hash and byte delta while retaining every other helper source. Baseline references derive trust from the external record hash, not from self-consistent candidate hashes.

Explicit build environment inputs include RUSTUP_HOME and the bound compiler; inherited environment is declared unrecorded. Cargo cache policy and its actual fresh field remain distinct. No external supply-chain or reproducible-build claim is made.
limits: The helper is not connected to caller/worker entry points. Existing bounded no-follow record reads, actual current source summary and executable descriptor verification still need integration and their ordinary checks.

All public saved-profile gates remain closed. Final literal/profile material, measured contract/frame/evidence sizes, actual artifact derivation and the separately released 16/16/4/4 passes remain pending.
The synthetic original/runnable/tool/log metadata is fixture data, not evidence that a compiler, strip command, record/replay workload, SQL connection, socket or service ran.
Concurrent BOSH matcher work is excluded from this two-file source map and checkpoint. No Rust source, legacy 113-test suite or other source qualification is renewed by these 33 helper tests.
Full Stage3 acceptance and later adapter/wire/TLS/retention/resource qualification remain open.
